svg.text: Owner review / Four decisions before implementation
Recommended direction: retain the canonical foundation, correct its institutional composition, and keep forms proportionate to the available evidence.
28 OCT 2026 | STRUCTURAL DESIGN ONLY | NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT PUBLICATION APPROVAL
Recommend recurring programme + editions; preserve existing activity IDs. Alternative: continue ungrouped basic-education records.
Recommend sourced managed cycle + distinct divisional executions. Alternative: retain virtual cohort grouping with no shared context owner.
Recommend bounded phases/sessions and separately evidenced application/results. Alternative: unstructured long body or configurable page builder.
Recommend exact-revision approval plus explicit publication; the same authorized person may do both. Sparse-content support is already approved and is
Still open: historical Rally/Pengenalan naming; detailed forum curricula; specific documentary conflicts. These do not justify inventing data or reopening settled institutional
Approval of this review is not backend, public redesign, schema, photo-use or Stage3-final-acceptance approval.
